<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,400;9..144,600&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
.ih{--ink:#16181a;--ink2:#23272b;--brass:#b8925a;--brass2:#d9b98a;--paper:#f7f5f1;--line:#e4e0d8;--muted:#6b6b6b;font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)}
.ih *{box-sizing:border-box}.ih a{text-decoration:none}
.ih .serif{font-family:Fraunces,Georgia,serif;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.ih .wrap{max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
.ih .eb{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--brass);font-weight:600}
.ih .eb:before{content:"";width:28px;height:1px;background:currentColor}
.ih h2{font-family:Fraunces,Georgia,serif;font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(1.9rem,4vw,3rem);line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:.8rem 0 1rem}
.ih p{line-height:1.65;margin:0}
.ih .btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;padding:1rem 1.6rem;font-weight:600;font-size:.92rem;border-radius:999px;transition:transform .2s,background .2s,color .2s}
.ih .btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.ih .b-brass{background:var(--brass);color:#16181a}.ih .b-brass:hover{background:var(--brass2)}
.ih .b-ghost{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);color:#fff}.ih .b-ghost:hover{background:#fff;color:var(--ink)}
.ih .b-dark{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}.ih .b-line{border:1px solid var(--ink);color:var(--ink)}.ih .b-line:hover{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.ih .reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px);transition:opacity .8s ease,transform .8s ease}.ih .reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
/* hero */
.ih-hero{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.ih-hero .g{display:grid;gap:2.5rem;padding-top:clamp(3rem,7vw,6rem);padding-bottom:clamp(3rem,7vw,6rem);align-items:center}@media(max-width:899px){.ih-hero .pic{aspect-ratio:4/3}.ih-hero .stats{gap:1.3rem}.ih-hero .stats b{font-size:1.5rem}.ih-hero .stats span{font-size:.66rem}}
@media(min-width:900px){.ih-hero .g{grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr}}
.ih-hero h1{font-family:Fraunces,Georgia,serif;font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(2.6rem,6.2vw,5.2rem);line-height:.98;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:1.2rem 0 1.4rem;color:#fff}
.ih-hero h1 em{font-style:italic;color:var(--brass2)}
.ih-hero .lead{color:#c9c9c9;font-size:1.08rem;max-width:520px;margin-bottom:2rem}
.ih-hero .stats{display:flex;gap:2.2rem;margin-top:2.6rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.ih-hero .stats b{display:block;font-family:Fraunces,Georgia,serif;font-size:2rem;color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.ih-hero .stats span{font-size:.78rem;color:#9a9a9a;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
.ih-hero .pic{position:relative;aspect-ratio:4/5;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;background:#2a2e33 center/cover no-repeat}
.ih-hero .pic:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 55%,rgba(0,0,0,.55))}
.ih-hero .scan{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#ffd9a0,transparent);box-shadow:0 0 18px 4px rgba(255,190,110,.55);animation:scan 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;z-index:2}
@keyframes scan{0%{top:12%}50%{top:82%}100%{top:12%}}
.ih-hero .tag{position:absolute;left:-18px;bottom:28px;z-index:3;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#e9e9e9,#bfc3c7 45%,#f4f4f4 60%,#a9adb2);color:#5b5f63;border-radius:12px;padding:14px 22px;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.45);font-family:Fraunces,Georgia,serif;font-size:1.15rem;letter-spacing:.08em;text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7),0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.35);transform:rotate(-4deg)}
@media(max-width:899px){.ih-hero .tag{left:12px}}
/* marquee */
.ih-mq{background:var(--brass);color:var(--ink);overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;padding:14px 0}
.ih-mq .t{display:inline-block;animation:mq 38s linear infinite;font-family:Fraunces,Georgia,serif;font-size:1.25rem}
.ih-mq .t span{margin:0 1.4rem}.ih-mq .t i{font-style:normal;opacity:.55}
@keyframes mq{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
/* packages */
.ih-sec{padding:clamp(3.5rem,8vw,6.5rem) 0}
.ih-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:2rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:2.6rem}
.ih-head p{color:var(--muted);max-width:440px}
.ih-pk{display:grid;gap:20px}@media(min-width:900px){.ih-pk{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
.ih-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:transform .3s,box-shadow .3s;color:var(--ink)}
.ih-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:0 24px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.10)}
.ih-card .im{aspect-ratio:4/3;overflow:hidden;background:#ddd}.ih-card .im img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .6s}.ih-card:hover .im img{transform:scale(1.06)}
.ih-card .bd{padding:1.6rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.7rem;flex:1}
.ih-card .tier{font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--brass);font-weight:600}
.ih-card h3{font-family:Fraunces,Georgia,serif;font-size:1.6rem;margin:0;font-weight:600}
.ih-card .pr{font-family:Fraunces,Georgia,serif;font-size:2.2rem;font-weight:600}.ih-card .pr small{font-family:Inter,sans-serif;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:400}
.ih-card .inc{color:var(--muted);font-size:.93rem;flex:1}
.ih-card .go{font-weight:600;font-size:.9rem;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:1rem;display:flex;justify-content:space-between}
.ih-card.dark{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border-color:var(--ink)}.ih-card.dark .inc{color:#b9b9b9}.ih-card.dark .go{border-color:#333}
.ih-card .pop{position:absolute;top:14px;right:14px;background:var(--brass);color:var(--ink);font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;padding:.35rem .7rem;border-radius:99px;text-transform:uppercase}
/* engrave demo */
.ih-demo{background:var(--paper)}
.ih-demo .g{display:grid;gap:3rem;align-items:center}@media(min-width:900px){.ih-demo .g{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.ih-demo input{width:100%;padding:1.05rem 1.2rem;border:1px solid #cfc9bd;border-radius:14px;font-size:1.05rem;background:#fff;margin:1.4rem 0 1rem;font-family:inherit}
.ih-demo .chips{display:flex;gap:.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.ih-demo .chips button{border:1px solid #cfc9bd;background:#fff;border-radius:99px;padding:.5rem 1rem;font:inherit;font-size:.85rem;cursor:pointer}
.ih-demo .chips button.on{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border-color:var(--ink)}
.ih-stage{position:relative;aspect-ratio:1/1;border-radius:24px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 20%,#2e3338,#121416);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}
.ih-obj{transition:all .5s ease;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;position:relative}
.ih-obj.key{width:62%;aspect-ratio:2.2/1;border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f0f0f0,#b9bec4 40%,#eceef0 58%,#9ea3a9);box-shadow:0 30px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.ih-obj.key:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-34px;top:50%;width:46px;height:46px;border:7px solid #b9bec4;border-radius:50%;transform:translateY(-50%)}
.ih-obj.pen{width:82%;height:13%;border-radius:40px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#5a6168,#1e2226 45%,#3b4248);box-shadow:0 26px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.ih-obj.pen:after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-6%;top:50%;width:9%;height:60%;transform:translateY(-50%);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#e9e9e9,#9da2a7);clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 50%,0 100%)}
.ih-obj.bottle{width:34%;height:80%;border-radius:40px 40px 30px 30px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#8d939a,#eef0f2 35%,#c4c9ce 60%,#7d838a);box-shadow:0 30px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.ih-obj.bottle:before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-9%;left:22%;width:56%;height:11%;background:#1b1e21;border-radius:10px 10px 4px 4px}
.ih-txt{font-family:Fraunces,Georgia,serif;font-weight:600;color:rgba(70,74,79,.92);text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.75),0 -1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.45);letter-spacing:.06em;line-height:1.1;word-break:break-word;padding:0 8%}
.ih-obj.key .ih-txt{font-size:clamp(1rem,2.6vw,1.7rem)}
.ih-obj.pen .ih-txt{font-size:clamp(.7rem,1.6vw,1rem);color:rgba(235,224,205,.9);text-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(255,210,150,.35);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase}
.ih-obj.bottle .ih-txt{font-size:clamp(.8rem,2vw,1.2rem);writing-mode:vertical-rl;transform:rotate(180deg);padding:0}
.ih-beam{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;width:2px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,#ffcf8a,transparent);box-shadow:0 0 22px 6px rgba(255,180,90,.5);left:-10%;opacity:0}
.ih-beam.go{animation:beam 1s ease}
@keyframes beam{0%{left:10%;opacity:1}100%{left:90%;opacity:0}}
/* products */
.ih-pg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:16px}@media(min-width:900px){.ih-pg{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:22px}}
.ih-p{color:var(--ink);display:block}
.ih-p .im{aspect-ratio:1/1;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;background:#eee;position:relative}
.ih-p .im img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .6s}.ih-p:hover .im img{transform:scale(1.07)}
.ih-p .im .q{position:absolute;left:10px;bottom:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);font-size:.72rem;font-weight:600;padding:.35rem .7rem;border-radius:99px;opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px);transition:.3s}
.ih-p:hover .im .q{opacity:1;transform:none}
.ih-p h4{font-size:.98rem;font-weight:600;margin:.9rem 0 .25rem}
.ih-p .pp{color:var(--muted);font-size:.88rem}.ih-p .pp b{color:var(--ink)}
/* steps */
.ih-steps{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.ih-st{display:grid;gap:0;margin-top:3rem;counter-reset:s}@media(min-width:900px){.ih-st{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}}
.ih-st div{padding:2rem 1.6rem 2rem 0;border-top:1px solid #3a3f44;position:relative}
.ih-st div:before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-1px;left:0;width:0;height:2px;background:var(--brass);transition:width 1.2s ease}
.ih-st.in div:before{width:100%}
.ih-st b{font-family:Fraunces,Georgia,serif;font-size:3.2rem;color:var(--brass);font-weight:600;display:block;line-height:1}
.ih-st h4{font-size:1.1rem;margin:1rem 0 .5rem}.ih-st p{color:#a9a9a9;font-size:.93rem}
/* planner */
.ih-plan{display:grid;gap:2rem;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px;padding:clamp(1.6rem,4vw,3rem)}@media(min-width:900px){.ih-plan{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;align-items:center}}
.ih-plan label{display:block;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:1.4rem}
.ih-plan .v{font-family:Fraunces,Georgia,serif;font-size:2rem;color:var(--ink);text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;display:block;margin:.3rem 0 .4rem}
.ih-plan input[type=range]{width:100%;accent-color:#b8925a}
.ih-res{background:var(--paper);border-radius:18px;padding:1.6rem}
/* who */
.ih-who{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px}@media(min-width:900px){.ih-who{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px}}
.ih-w{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:1.6rem;background:#fff;transition:.3s}
.ih-w:hover{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border-color:var(--ink);transform:translateY(-4px)}.ih-w:hover p{color:#bbb}
.ih-w .ic{font-size:1.6rem;margin-bottom:.8rem;display:block}
.ih-w h4{font-family:Fraunces,Georgia,serif;font-size:1.25rem;margin:0 0 .4rem;font-weight:600}.ih-w p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem}
/* story + cta */
.ih-story .g{display:grid;gap:3rem;align-items:center}@media(min-width:900px){.ih-story .g{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.ih-story .ph{aspect-ratio:4/5;border-radius:24px;background:#ccc center/cover no-repeat}
.ih-story blockquote{font-family:Fraunces,Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(1.4rem,2.6vw,2rem);line-height:1.25;margin:1rem 0 1.4rem;font-style:italic}
.ih-pr{display:grid;gap:1rem;margin:1.6rem 0 2rem}.ih-pr div{display:flex;gap:1rem;align-items:flex-start}.ih-pr b{font-family:Fraunces,Georgia,serif;color:var(--brass);font-size:1.2rem;min-width:1.6rem}
.ih-cta{background:var(--brass);color:var(--ink);text-align:center}
.ih-cta h2{font-size:clamp(2.2rem,5vw,4rem);max-width:900px;margin:0 auto 1.2rem}
</style><style>
:root{--font-heading--family:Fraunces,Georgia,serif;--font-body--family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;--font-subheading--family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif}
body{font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif}
main h1,main h2{font-family:Fraunces,Georgia,serif!important;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-weight:600}
main h4{font-family:Fraunces,Georgia,serif}
.button,button.button,a.button{border-radius:999px!important}
main table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:.8rem 0 1rem;font-size:.92rem}
main th,main td{border-bottom:1px solid #e4e0d8;padding:.65rem .4rem;text-align:left}
main th{font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6b6b6b;font-weight:600}
main tr:nth-child(2) td{font-weight:600}
main a[href*="wa.me"]:not(.btn){display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;background:#25D366;color:#fff!important;padding:.8rem 1.4rem;border-radius:999px;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none!important;margin-top:.4rem}
main ol li,main ul li{margin-bottom:.35rem}
/* page components */
.ih-band{background:var(--ink,#16181a);color:#fff;padding:clamp(3rem,7vw,5.5rem) 0;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.ih-band:after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-120px;top:-120px;width:380px;height:380px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(184,146,90,.35)}
.ih-band h1{font-family:Fraunces,Georgia,serif;font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(2.3rem,5.5vw,4.2rem);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:1rem 0 1rem;color:#fff}
.ih-band p{color:#c4c4c4;max-width:620px;font-size:1.05rem}
.ih-band .crumb{font-size:.8rem;color:#8d8d8d;margin-bottom:.6rem}.ih-band .crumb a{color:#8d8d8d}
.ih-chips{display:flex;gap:.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:1.6rem}.ih-chips span{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);border-radius:99px;padding:.45rem .9rem;font-size:.8rem;color:#e6e6e6}
.ih-lsteps{display:grid;gap:16px;margin:1rem 0 2.5rem}@media(min-width:750px){.ih-lsteps{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
.ih-lsteps div{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:1.6rem;background:#fff}
.ih-lsteps b{font-family:Fraunces,Georgia,serif;font-size:2.4rem;color:var(--brass);line-height:1;display:block}
.ih-lsteps h3{font-family:Fraunces,Georgia,serif;font-size:1.3rem;margin:.8rem 0 .4rem}.ih-lsteps p{color:var(--muted)}
.ih-box{background:var(--paper);border-radius:20px;padding:clamp(1.4rem,3vw,2.2rem);margin:1.5rem 0}
.ih-box h3{font-family:Fraunces,Georgia,serif;font-size:1.4rem;margin:0 0 .8rem}
.ih-box ul{margin:0;padding-left:1.1rem;color:var(--muted)}
.ih-faq details{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:1.2rem 0}
.ih-faq summary{cursor:pointer;font-family:Fraunces,Georgia,serif;font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:600;list-style:none;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem}
.ih-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ih-faq summary:after{content:"+";color:var(--brass);font-size:1.5rem;line-height:1;transition:transform .3s}
.ih-faq details[open] summary:after{transform:rotate(45deg)}.ih-faq details p{color:var(--muted);margin-top:.7rem}
.ih-ctabox{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border-radius:22px;padding:clamp(1.8rem,4vw,3rem);margin-top:2.5rem;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:1.4rem;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.ih-ctabox h3{font-family:Fraunces,Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(1.4rem,3vw,2rem);margin:0;color:#fff;max-width:520px}
.ih-trust{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:1px;background:var(--line);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden}@media(min-width:900px){.ih-trust{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}}
.ih-trust div{background:#fff;padding:1.4rem}.ih-trust b{font-family:Fraunces,Georgia,serif;font-size:1.1rem;display:block;margin-bottom:.3rem}.ih-trust p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.88rem}
.ih-foot{background:#16181a;color:#cfcfcf;padding:clamp(3rem,6vw,4.5rem) 0 2rem}
.ih-foot .cols{display:grid;gap:2.2rem}@media(min-width:900px){.ih-foot .cols{grid-template-columns:1.6fr 1fr 1fr 1.2fr}}
.ih-foot h5{color:#fff;font-size:.75rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 1rem;font-family:Inter,sans-serif}
.ih-foot a{color:#cfcfcf;display:block;margin-bottom:.55rem;font-size:.93rem}.ih-foot a:hover{color:var(--brass2)}
.ih-foot .logo{font-family:Fraunces,Georgia,serif;font-size:1.9rem;color:#fff;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.ih-foot .tl{color:#9a9a9a;margin:.6rem 0 1.4rem;max-width:320px;font-size:.93rem;line-height:1.6}
</style>
